author: NuclearDucky
body:
Avicus has a lot of cool plugins. But there is one it for some reason does not have. /ignore. /ignore could be used as a tool to ignore people spamming chat, harassing, or trolling.

Pros: Less annoying, more enjoyable

Cons: Players may just use this against spammers instead of reporting. If people spam and dont get reported, just ignored, it'll be harder to punish them.

If a player attempts to ignore a STAFF member, it wont work.
